note: Re-judged 2026-10-19 (independent auditor, after d64411a639 and 08bfef9ee7). Section 4.2: "Note: A compliant implementation MUST NOT allow instantiation of an ESP SA that employs both NULL encryption and no integrity algorithm." d64411a639 makes NULL encryption reachable for IKE Child SAs, so every instantiation path was re-read for NULL + no integrity. Config: parseESPProposal requires a hash for every non-AEAD cipher and null is non-AEAD (TestIntegrityOnlyESPConfig, 'hash is required'). Negotiation: initiator NegotiateESP runs espProposalComplete, which now refuses ENCR_NULL beside AUTH_NONE (RFC 4303 Section 3.2 quoted above it; TestIntegrityOnlyESPRefusals asserts ErrProposalIncomplete); responder matchOfferedESP passes a non-zero integID for a non-AEAD local proposal and espProposalMatches requires the offer to contain it. XFRM: planStateAlgos gives non-AEAD ESP Crypt+Auth and xfrmAuthNames holds no '' or 'none', so TestRFC4301ESPNullEncryptionWithoutIntegrityIsRefused (refused, no state) and the NULL+sha256 positive stand. VPP: vppCryptoAlg now names null as CRYPTO_ALG_NONE, so the refusal moved to vppIntegAlg, whose default arm refuses '' and 'none' beside a non-AEAD cipher; the changed TestRFC4301VPPESPNullEncryptionWithoutIntegrityIsRefused keeps the control install (1 message) and asserts ErrNotSupported with zero VPP messages for '' and 'none'. Dropped from it: the null+sha256 refusal case and the vppCryptoAlg('null') error assertion, both of which asserted behaviour RFC 4303 Section 1 now requires to be absent; that is a correction, not a weakening (owner-approval debt row for 08bfef9ee7 is open). OSPF manual SAs unchanged (validateIPsecInterface both polarities). All units pass at HEAD with and without -tags ze_vpp. Finding, no verdict change: the new VPP negative record breaks vppIntegAlg with a panic, which would also redden the control install, so it shows the unit reaches vppIntegAlg rather than that the default arm is the refusal; a record making vppIntegAlg return INTEG_ALG_NONE for '' would discriminate the refusal itself.
